questions.prompt: In the last 6 weeks, have you had a sudden fever (≥38°C / 100.4°F) AND severe muscle aches (especially thighs, hips, back)?
questions.help: Hantavirus typically starts 1–8 weeks after exposure with flu-like illness.

options.label: Yes — both fever and severe muscle aches

questions.prompt: Are you short of breath, coughing, or feeling chest tightness?
questions.help: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) progresses rapidly to lung involvement. This is an emergency sign.

questions.prompt: In the last 6 weeks, were you on the MV Atlantic Voyager OR in contact with someone who was, OR did you visit areas with known rodent infestations?
questions.help: Transmission is via aerosolized rodent urine/droppings or, in rare strains, human-to-human in close quarters.

options.label: Yes — on MV Atlantic Voyager since 28 Apr 2026
Yes — close contact with a passenger/crew member

questions.prompt: Any of these: severe headache, dizziness, chills, nausea/vomiting, abdominal pain, blurred vision?
questions.help: These accompany the prodromal phase before respiratory or kidney complications.
